diagram.name: BRFN Digital Marketplace - i* SD Model

customProperties.Description: Strategic Dependency model for the Bristol Regional Food Network digital marketplace, taken from the same piStar model as the SR by collapsing every actor, so both views share one set of elements. It has eight actors: Customer, Producer, Marketplace Platform, Marketplace Administrator, Payment Service, Certification Verification Service, and two actors added in the Sprint 2 refinement, Notification Service and BRFN (Marketplace Operator). The 43 dependencies (9 goals, 13 qualities, 20 resources, 1 task) cover Use Case 1 (product listing and inventory), Use Case 2 (multi-vendor checkout and payment) and Use Case 3 (food-safety incidents and traceability). They include the dependencies behind three tensions, which the SR model makes visible with help/hurt links: traceability vs privacy (Traceable order records vs Personal data protected), suspension vs fair handling (Unsafe product suspended vs Fair incident handling) and commission vs payout (Commission calculated vs Fair payout terms).
